title: Nine higher-fidelity icon explorations
note: Four base-color families per concept with tonal shading. New raster explorations using first-round concept references; original assets unchanged.

icons.name: YumChase Y1
icons.title: Peach Mochi
icons.concept: Evolve the delighted lip-licking face into one pillowy, asymmetrical cream mochi-shaped character head. Two closed joyful eyes, a wide plum smile, and one broad peach tongue licking the corner. No limbs, no cheeks or decorative marks, no nose. A soft 3D sculpted confection, velvety matte surface, broad controlled highlights, subtle contact depth. Coral full-bleed background. Original adult-friendly mascot, not a standard emoji.

icons.name: YumChase Y2
icons.title: Cherry Smile
icons.concept: Retain the concept of two closed-eye arcs and a generous lip-licking smile, but reinterpret the features as beautifully sculpted raised vanilla enamel shapes with a petal-pink tongue and restrained burgundy recessed depth. No enclosing face circle or badge: the face features themselves are the single emblem on a full-bleed cherry background. Rich, tactile, smooth ceramic-enamel polish; rounded bevels, soft localized highlights. Premium food-loving joy, not garish emoji or neon.

icons.name: YumChase Y3
icons.title: Mint Bowl
icons.concept: Explore a different food-loving symbol: one mint ceramic bowl with a simple smooth cream dome of rice, integrated as a single compact mascot. The front of the bowl has two curved ink eyes and a delighted ink smile with a small broad coral tongue. No grains, steam, garnish, utensils, limbs or secondary props. Cream full-bleed background, strong mint/ink silhouette. High-fidelity smooth 2.5D ceramic illustration with restrained highlights and well-defined volume. The reference provides the happy expression only, not a layout to copy.

icons.name: ChompChase C1
icons.title: Tangerine Buddy
icons.concept: Evolve the reference's original bean-shaped chomping head into a plush sculpted tangerine character in side profile: one large round eye with cream surround and midnight pupil, a wide open midnight mouth, exactly two blunt cream teeth, and a single mint tongue as a small accent. No body, ears, horns, limbs, food or particles. Midnight full-bleed background. Refined matte clay with soft broad highlights, gentle volume and a crisply readable silhouette. Cheerful and hungry, never aggressive. Avoid perfect circular bodies, Pac-Man, known mascots and bitten fruit marks.

icons.name: UmamiChase U1
icons.title: Porcini Porcelain
icons.concept: Evolve the broad savory mushroom from the reference into one beautifully sculpted porcini-like mushroom: a chestnut domed cap, stout cream stem, and one broad ochre underside band. Rich aubergine full-bleed background. High-fidelity glazed-porcelain 2.5D illustration with subtle broad glaze highlights, elegant smooth contours and controlled shadow. Slight three-quarter view while preserving the strong cap-and-stem silhouette. No speckles, detailed gills, grass, face, extra mushrooms or psychedelic symbolism. Savory and sophisticated rather than woodland fantasy.

icons.name: UmamiChase U3
icons.title: Forest Fold
icons.concept: Reinterpret the iconic broad mushroom as an elegant layered-paper sculpture: one rounded moss-green cap, one wide ochre underside crescent, a short cream stem, and deep-forest background. Make the three-dimensional layered edges and broad soft shadows beautifully resolved, with a subtle folded curve through the cap, but no actual paper grain or fine texture. One unified mushroom silhouette, no scenery, spots, tiny gills, face or ornamental objects. Full-bleed forest square. Editorial, tactile and premium; this should feel distinctly different from a ceramic render.
